summary.text: Cliff Groh is a Democratic attorney and former state representative who is the candidate for Alaska House of Representatives District 18 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Dan Sager (R).
He represented District 18 in the Alaska House from 2023 to 2025.

paragraphs.text: Groh was born in Anchorage and lives there.
His career experience includes working as a prosecutor and city attorney, in the Alaska State Legislature, and as a special assistant to the Alaska commissioner of revenue.
Groh lost the 2018 primary for Alaska House District 20, won District 18 in 2022, and lost the 2024 general election for the seat.
In the 2023-2024 session he was assigned to the House Judiciary and Armed Services committees.
He advanced from the August 18, 2026 primary with 65.1 percent of the vote.
